method: Same local browser session, full-map view and mouse orbit. CPU submission time is a diagnostic, not a guaranteed GPU frame rate. Before capture followed an orbit with continuous rendering; after uses demand rendering, cached shadows and overview furniture detail. Initial loading/shadow frames excluded from the after movement sample.
notes: Original detailed geometry is retained and restored in close views.
Read-only map instances keep original source object IDs for picking and selection.
Architectural and furniture batches use 8 m spatial cells for culling.
The editor remains editable without static instancing.
Camera movement reuses shadows; object edits, visibility changes and texture loads invalidate them.
Rendering stops after camera damping and the final settled quality frame.

browserChecks: Distant detail returns to original geometry on zoom
Walls can be hidden and restored after batching
Idle frame counter remains unchanged (195 to 195)
Close G10 view captures reflections after settling

historicalNote: This earlier measurement used distant geometry simplification. That simplification has since been removed at the owner’s request.
